wikidot5e:spell:dragons-breath.effectSummary: Touch one willing creature that has a mouth and choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. Until the spell ends, it can use an action to exhale a 15-foot cone; creatures there make Dexterity saves, taking 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a failure or half on a success. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d6 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:drawmijs-instant-summons.effectSummary: Touch an object weighing no more than 10 pounds and no longer than 6 feet in any dimension. The spell invisibly marks it and inscribes its name on the unique sapphire used for this casting. Later, as an action, speak the item's name and crush that sapphire: if the item is not being held or carried by another creature, it appears in your hand regardless of physical or planar distance and the spell ends. If another creature holds or carries it, it is not transported; instead you learn that creature's identity and the item's approximate location at that moment. Dispel magic or a similar successful effect on the sapphire ends the spell.

wikidot5e:spell:dream.effectSummary: Choose a known creature on your plane that sleeps. You or a willing creature you touch becomes the messenger, entering a trance in which it is aware of surroundings but cannot move or act. If the target sleeps, the messenger appears in its dream, can converse and shape the dream environment, and may end the trance early; the target remembers the dream perfectly. If the target is awake, the messenger knows and can end the spell or wait for it to sleep. Instead, the messenger may appear terrifying, deliver a message of up to ten words, then force a Wisdom save; on a failure a nightmare prevents benefit from that sleep and the target takes 3d6 psychic damage when it wakes. Possessing a body part, hair, nail clipping, or similar piece of the target gives it disadvantage on this save.

wikidot5e:spell:dream-of-the-blue-veil.effectSummary: You and up to eight willing creatures in range become unconscious and see visions of another Material Plane world for 6 hours. If the full duration completes, all still affected are transported physically and mentally to that world. Casting requires awareness of that world and either a magic item originating there or an affected creature born there. With an item, the destination is a safe place within 1 mile of where it was created; with a native creature, within 1 mile of its birthplace. Damage ends the spell early for the damaged creature, which is not transported. If you take damage, the spell ends for everyone and nobody is transported.

wikidot5e:spell:druid-grove.effectSummary: Ward an outdoor or underground area from a 30-foot cube up to a 90-foot cube, excluding buildings and structures, for 24 hours; casting it in the same area every day for a year makes it last until dispelled. At casting, designate friends immune to the effects and optionally a password whose speaker becomes immune. The whole area is magical, but a successful dispel magic removes only one chosen ward effect; the grove ends only when all effects are gone. Solid Fog: fill any number of ground-level 5-foot squares with 10-foot-high heavy-obscuring fog; each foot traveled costs 2 extra feet, while immune creatures see through it normally. Grasping Undergrowth: fill other chosen ground-level 5-foot squares with weeds and vines using entangle's restraining-area mechanics; immune creatures are unhindered. Grove Guardians: animate up to four trees with awakened-tree statistics except they cannot speak; they attack nonimmune intruders, obey your spoken commands while you are in the area, cannot leave, and root again when the spell ends if possible. Additional Spell Effect: also place either constant gust of wind in two locations, spike growth in one location, or wind wall in two locations; immune creatures treat the winds as a gentle breeze and spike growth as harmless.

wikidot5e:spell:druidcraft.effectSummary: Create one minor nature effect in range: a harmless sensory sign lasting 1 round that predicts local weather for the next 24 hours; instantly make a flower blossom, seed pod open, or leaf bud bloom; create an instantaneous harmless sensory effect fitting within a 5-foot cube; or instantly light or extinguish a candle, torch, or small campfire.

wikidot5e:spell:dust-devil.effectSummary: Create a dust devil in a visible unoccupied 5-foot cube. A creature ending its turn within 5 feet makes a Strength save, taking 1d8 bludgeoning damage and being pushed 10 feet away on a failure, or half damage without the push on a success. As a bonus action, move the devil up to 30 feet in any direction. If it passes over sand, dust, loose dirt, or small gravel, it creates a 10-foot-radius heavily obscuring debris cloud around itself until the start of your next turn. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d8 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:earth-tremor.effectSummary: Each other creature on the ground within 10 feet makes a Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage and falls prone. Loose earth or stone in the area becomes difficult terrain until cleared. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d6 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:earthbind.effectSummary: One visible creature in range makes a Strength save. On a failure, its flying speed becomes 0 for the duration. An affected airborne creature descends at 60 feet per round until it reaches the ground or the spell ends.

wikidot5e:spell:earthquake.effectSummary: Create a 100-foot-radius seismic disturbance centered on visible ground in range. The ground becomes difficult terrain. A creature concentrating while on the ground there makes a Constitution save or loses concentration. When cast and at the end of each turn you continue concentrating, each creature on the ground there makes a Dexterity save or falls prone. The DM may add terrain effects. Fissures: at the start of your next turn, 1d6 fissures open at DM-chosen locations; each is 1d10×10 feet deep, 10 feet wide, and spans the area. A creature where one opens makes a Dexterity save or falls in; on a success it moves with the edge. A fissure beneath a structure automatically collapses it. Structures: when cast and at the start of each of your turns, the tremor deals 50 bludgeoning damage to every structure touching the ground in the area. A structure reduced to 0 HP collapses; creatures within half its height make Dexterity saves, taking 5d6 bludgeoning damage, falling prone, and becoming buried on a failure, or half damage without prone/burial on a success. A buried creature can use an action for a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to escape, with the DM able to adjust the DC for the rubble.
